_purpose: Rule 13 registry: every artifact this repo generates that gets INSTALLED somewhere the repo cannot see (a live WordPress site). Consumed by tests/test_hop3_surface_registry.py, which gates the inventory table in CLAUDE.md. The table is no longer hand-maintained prose — a new live-write surface cannot merge without either a hop 2->3 executor or an explicit, recorded reason it has none.
_why: Rule 13 was written from the newest tool, and on the day it was written 3 of the 4 tools it named did not satisfy its own --check requirement, while six further 3-hop surfaces were not in the table at all. Undetectable drift reads exactly like no drift.
_contract: executor != null  =>  the module must expose --check and exit non-zero on drift (scripts/_core/hop3_drift.py owns that mapping). executor == null => unguarded_reason is REQUIRED and states the blast radius, so the gap is disclosed rather than silently absent.

surfaces.scope_correction: The audit ranked this the highest-blast-radius gap on the premise that org identity is frozen into every post body. Verified false on 2026-08-05: on projects where RankMath emits Organization in the document HEAD, the pipeline deliberately skips that type, and the head node renders LIVE from WP options — so it is not a 3-hop artifact there and updates itself. project-alpha's bodies carry FAQPage + ItemList only. The checker therefore treats an ABSENT org node as 'not applicable', and only compares values where a project genuinely bakes one in. Reporting absence as drift would have fired on every post of every such project.

surfaces.verified: Live 2026-08-05: rank-math bridge in sync on all 13 hosts. Reads bridge_version over REST, so it needs no shell access. A bridge for an SEO plugin the site does not run is not_applicable, NOT not_deployed — the first run reported the Yoast bridge missing on all 13 projects, which is noise, because the fleet runs RankMath.

Live sweep 2026-08-05 found real drift the fleet could not previously see: loamwright 44/56, project-hotel 21/32, project-charlie 12/106 published posts carry signature wording that no longer matches the configured template; project-alpha 3/3 in sync. Detection only — repair is a separate deliberate act.

surfaces.verified: Live 2026-08-05: project-alpha and loamwright in sync. Scope is deliberately narrow: a body linking somewhere the map does not list is EDITORIAL, not drift; the finding that matters is a link that no longer resolves. Enumeration is a pre-filter only — the verdict comes from an actual HTTP status, after the first run called three WooCommerce product URLs dead because /wp/v2/product was not in the enumeration list.

Live 2026-08-05: loamwright 229 terms in sync. Compares description, name and rank_math_* per term instead of only term IDs; HTML-escaping and curly quotes are normalised away so ordinary round-tripping is not reported as drift.
